properties.rationale: Third-party JS cannot survive a swap; partial rendering is decided by render.IsPartial + the page() dispatch.
properties.statement: Boosting is shell-wide (hx-boost on <main>); opt a subtree out with hx-boost="false" or render.ForceReload where a full navigation is wanted, and never hand-branch a page on HX-Request.

properties.rationale: A disappearing failure message is a silent failure; the two definitions (toastDurationMs server, toastDuration client) must stay in step.
properties.statement: An error toast is persistent (duration 0, no auto-dismiss, explicit close button); success/info/warning auto-dismiss and are click-dismissable. The severity→duration rule has one definition per side.

properties.rationale: A theme tweak must not fail a unit test, and a contract regression must not pass one.
properties.statement: Render/unit tests assert the contract — ids, data-testid, aria-*, hx-*, data-* — and omission where it matters; never class strings or class order.

properties.rationale: Agent/LLM output is untrusted and is the primary injection vector into the shell.
properties.statement: Never innerHTML agent-produced content: render markdown through renderMarkdown (goldmark + bluemonday UGCPolicy) and then templ.Raw; for a plain string use textContent.

properties.rationale: Landing a non-admin on a page that degrades to a 403 is worse than not showing the link.
properties.statement: A control the caller's role cannot use must not render at all — never render it disabled; derive the role once from the org access tree and omit admin-only nav entries entirely.

properties.rationale: Produces an element that renders visible while Alpine's data says hidden (issue #1267); the adopted platform fix is the hx-alpine-compat extension (#1275), not an htmx upgrade.
properties.statement: An Alpine-toggled element that carries an id must either have no id, render its closed state server-side (style="display:none"), or use x-if/<template> — because htmx v4 restores attributes on same-id elements across a swap and drops x-show's inline display.

properties.rationale: data-* delegation is the established single-file pattern and its attributes are what the unit contract tests assert on.
properties.statement: Prefer an existing go-daisy L0 widget; for a genuinely custom control prefer data-* delegation in app.js; reach for Alpine only when the widget needs reactive local state.

properties.rationale: One-off extraction multiplies surface area without reuse; inlining is cheaper until a second call site proves it.
properties.statement: Components sit in layers L0 go-daisy primitive → L1 domain adapter → L2 app composite → L3 page-local helper → L4 page, and imports flow down only; extraction is earned at ≥2 call sites or when the component encapsulates an invariant (ids, data-testid, aria-*, htmx wiring).

properties.rationale: A swap region whose contract is a component cannot be composed; overrides must stay with the caller.
properties.statement: The page/integration site owns hx-target, hx-swap, hx-trigger and hx-include (passed via Attrs); a component may own only self-contained hints meaningless without it (data-copy-target, data-dialog-autoopen).

properties.rationale: A boosted 303 swaps only #main-content, leaving shell chrome (topbar, sidebar badges) stale; RedirectAfterMutation gives htmx an HX-Redirect and plain browsers a 303.
properties.statement: Every mutation follows post → 303/HX-Redirect → flagged GET → flashToasts; errors ride ?err= through redirectWithError.
